title: Tariff Bench
description: Estimate device electricity costs and compare BC Hydro plans or Nova Scotia Power standard rates.

data_info.detail: Private device and household inputs with manually reviewed BC Hydro and Nova Scotia Power residential tariffs, effective April/May 2026; reviewed November 24, 2026. Monthly ENERGY STAR Canadian-market appliance model snapshots provide rated annual kWh.
data_info.cadence: Monthly appliance checks; tariffs reviewed manually
